text:
[Council File 26-1394]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
PUBLIC SAFETY COMMITTEE REPORT relative to a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) between the City of Los Angeles and Axon Enterprise, Inc., for the Lightpost Test Pilot Program.
Recommendation for Council action:
VETO, pursuant to Charter Section 245, the September 22, 2026 action of the Board of Police Commissioners approving the MOU between the City of Los Angeles and Axon Enterprise, Inc., for the Lightpost Test Pilot Program.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
None submitted by the Board of Police Commissioners. Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
TIME LIMIT FILE - OCTOBER 27, 2026
(LAST DAY FOR COUNCIL ACTION - OCTOBER 27, 2026)
